title: Exact validation-plan read without wildcard roots
failure_signature: A source-exclusion lookup combined a concrete documentation root with a wildcard scripts path and returned Windows invalid-path error 123.
trigger_preconditions: A closeout preflight needs exact inherited validation exclusions.
Search scope spans a known phase plan and optionally version-filtered scripts.
candidate_workaround: Read the exact inherited final-validation-plan directly and use a concrete scripts root with -g only if supporting implementation lookup is still necessary.
recurrence_guard: Run a pre-execution argument check that rejects wildcard characters in every rg root argument; exact known files must be read directly.
rollback: Discard the partial lookup, retain error 123, and perform one exact-file read for the authoritative exclusion list.
scope_boundary: Read-only closeout preflight only; no test execution, canonical pass, replay, or independent-reproduction credit.
